subject: Instrumentation ownership & ops charter for observability handoff - ClarityHealth
messages:
From: Ethan Walker <ethan.walker@clarityhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability kickoff and runbook / ownership questions

Hi Marissa / Laura,

Thanks again for yesterday's demo — the team liked the latency dashboards and the trace sampling controls. We wanted to align on who at ClarityHealth will own what for the ops handoff: dashboards, tracing hook placement, error taxonomy, and alert routing.

Two quick asks so we can finalize our internal kickoff on Monday:
1) A one-page breakpoint listing of what Redwood expects the customer to instrument vs. what Redwood will wire up (especially for service-to-service trace context).
2) A draft runbook we can review that includes escalation contacts and on-call expectations for the first 90 days.

I'll cc the implementation team — Priya will coordinate the API keys and network allowlist. Are you able to share a suggested assignment matrix today so we can pre-fill our playbook?

Thanks,
Ethan
---
Ethan Walker
Engineering Manager, Integrations
ClarityHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ethan.walker@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priya Mehra <priya.mehra@clarityhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability kickoff and runbook / ownership questions

Ethan — thanks for the clear list. Quick response with an initial split and attachments: I attached an instrumentation ownership matrix (clarity_instrumentation_matrix_v1.csv) and a first-pass runbook draft. High-level:

- Redwood (Ben): we'll provide the tracing hook implementation guidance, sample middleware, and host-level APM dashboards. We'll also wire default alert routing to your on-call Slack channel and provide playbook steps for failover to the Redwood fallback model.
- ClarityHealth (Ethan / Priya): owners for application-level span annotations, business error tagging (their error taxonomy), and service key rotation.

Concrete next steps:
- Ben, can you confirm the exact header names we recommend for trace context so their infra can add them to the gateway?
- Ethan / Priya, please review the attached ownership matrix and mark any rows that need changes.

I'll schedule a 30-minute alignment tomorrow afternoon to lock owners and acceptance criteria.

Attachments: clarity_instrumentation_matrix_v1.csv, runbook_draft_clarity.md

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ethan Walker <ethan.walker@clarityhealth.com>, Priya Mehra <priya.mehra@clarityhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Oct 2028 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability kickoff and runbook / ownership questions

Quick technical note here — high priority for the gateway change: please add our trace header 'X-REDWOOD-TRACE' plus preserve incoming W3C traceparent headers. Minimal guidance below for Priya's team:

- Gateway / LB: add 'X-REDWOOD-TRACE' mutation so downstream services see the same id for server spans.
- SDKs: instrument at HTTP client level for outbound calls and attach business_error_code tags (see runbook section 3).
- Sampling: start with 0.5% adaptive sampling for production per our recommendation; we can increase during ramp.

I've updated the attached runbook draft with the header names and a short snippet of middleware for Node + Python. Also included a section on alert routing: primary channel -> #clarity-oncall (Slack), secondary -> email to infra-oncall@clarityhealth.com, tertiary -> Redwood escalation (on-call pager).

I'll bring these into the alignment call.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Platform Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Walker <ethan.walker@clarityhealth.com>, Priya Mehra <priya.mehra@clarityhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Oct 2028 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observability kickoff and runbook / ownership questions

Thanks everyone — great alignment today. Summary / acceptance checklist (action items and owners):

- Clarity to add X-REDWOOD-TRACE and preserve traceparent at gateway (Owner: Priya) — target: 2028-10-18
- Clarity to annotate business_error_code on user-facing services (Owner: Ethan) — target: 2028-10-20
- Redwood to deliver final runbook v1 with Node/Python snippets and alert routing configs (Owner: Ben) — target: 2028-10-15 (attached: runbook_draft_clarity.md)
- Joint review of dashboards and alert thresholds (Meeting: 2028-10-19 14:00 PT) — invite sent

Please update the ownership matrix with any changes before EOD Monday. I'm attaching a compact dashboards overview (dashboards-overview.pdf) for the review meeting.

If there are any blockers on network allowlist or API keys, Priya, ping me and I'll coordinate with our infra team to speed it up.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0198
